post.description:
Allows a logged-in user to change their password.

Requires:

post.description:
Creates a new user account with the provided information and returns JWT tokens.

Behavior:
• Account is created with `is_active=True`
• Parent role assigned by default
• Access and refresh JWT tokens are provided upon registration
• Email verification is optional and can be done later via `/verify-email/`

post.description: Sends an OTP to the authenticated user's email if it is not already verified.
Takes a valid refresh token and returns a new access token (and optionally a new refresh token). This is the standard way to keep the user session alive without requiring re-authentication.

Child.description:
Serializer for a child **user** along with profile details.

This works against the `User` model; a related `Child` profile
record stores the age/age_group/avatar data.  The serializer ensures the
associated user gets the CHILD role and parent attribution when created.

Exposed fields:
  - id, email, first_name, last_name (from User)
  - age, age_group, avatar, pseudo (from Child profile)

age.description: Age of the child in years (between 1 and 17).

age_group.description: Age group of the child (e.g., 5-8, 9-12, etc.).

avatar.description: URL to child avatar image stored in a bucket.
